title: The size rows in the Layout section match the auto-layout mock, or the mock is changed by your answer
goal: The auto-layout mock gives a frame one Frame size row with Hug, Narrow and Wide. The app gives a group or an arranging screen two rows, Width and Height, each Hug or Fixed, with the number typed in W and H. Decide which one the Layout section should show.
notes: Raised by a-screen-can-hug-what-it-holds (2026-10-08): its audit compares the shipped Width/Height rows against ui-autolayout.html lines ~281-288 (Frame size: Hug | Narrow | Wide). The group rows have had this shape since auto layout landed; no decision ever settled it. Sources/Photonz/ArrangementInspector.swift sizeRows.
acceptance: A decision card on this task is answered by the user

If the answer is the mock row, the Layout section shows one Frame size row as ui-autolayout.html draws it, for groups and arranging screens alike, and the walks that press Hug or Fixed in Width or Height are updated
If the answer keeps Width and Height, this task closes with nothing built
